decision: The CLI includes a graph command that emits Graphviz DOT for relationships around a starting spec ID. The command traverses both outgoing references and backlinks up to a configurable depth, can include or exclude specific spec types, writes to stdout by default, and can write to a requested output path. Graph output supports profiles: docs is the default readable documentation profile with structured labels, focus highlighting, softer layout styling, and collapsed noisy values; compact is a smaller presentation-oriented variant; debug preserves the raw relationship graph for inspection.
name: Generate Graphviz relationship graphs
description: Documents the Graphviz DOT CLI export so Grounded relationship graphs can be generated from the same canonical registry references used by rendered docs.
